purpose: 원본 무기와 v2 효과를 연결한 연출 시제품. 실제 전투 판정은 별도 구현.

source: Existing original weapon plus generated v2 component GLBs; local binary composition and standard TRS retiming.

runtime.opacity: Node extras.runtime_fade is a separate browser/engine opacity recipe, not an embedded material animation.
runtime.fade_time_mapping: start + sourceSeconds / sourceDuration * (end - start); harpoon end may extend to visible_until.
runtime.loop: loop=true is optional comparison playback repetition only. A gameplay one-shot uses LoopOnce; state adapters stop when their real state ends.
runtime.axes: +Y up; muzzle +Z; impact source +Y normal rotated toward -Z in this preview.
runtime.mortar_launch: Only the mortar launch wrapper rotates X -PI/2 so source +Z points +Y. Projectile +Y arc and local Z4 arrival remain unchanged.
runtime.harpoon_hold: Projectile and tether wrapper persists until 2.7 seconds; source final TRS must remain visible. Preview cable endpoints are not runtime physics.
runtime.flame_overlap: Ignition 0–0.4s, stream 0.15–2.6s, contact 0.5–2.9s. Stream authored scale is preserved; target at Z1.85 is a visual hypothesis needing fresh render.
reset: stop and reset action/mixer/time to zero
restore per-instance opacity and outline settings

limits: Visual prototype, not a collision/damage/fuel/physics implementation.
Approximate muzzle from source geometry, not a validated engine socket or muzzleFrame authority.
Embedded projectile translation is a study; gameplay uses only the geometry subtree and owns projectile world motion. Only actual collision/contact events select impacts.
Resolve v2 by effect ID after integration checks; missing or unverified v2 uses v1 fallback. Do not use this whole sequence as a combat event source.
The target is an abstract comparison prop. Source dimensions and clip time are art hypotheses.
Original weapon texture remains embedded; four zero normals may be repaired only in a copied chain-shot weapon.

changes: Add stable component wrapper names, transform/geometry-subtree and byte/hash metadata; expose preview loop/reset/fallback limitations.
concerns: Fresh game-camera render is required to judge silhouette, small-screen legibility, muzzle/target occlusion and removal gate.
Current output snapshot precedes source-only correction and the parent asset refresh. Do not claim this audit as v2 visual approval.
expected_observations: 0.5s: rope grows from local Z0 toward the moving head without moving its muzzle endpoint.
1.3s: head reaches local Z4; source head scale remains [1,1,1] and source rope scale holds Z4.
1.8s and 2.68s: cable and head are still visible after arrival; this is preview cable geometry, not runtime rope physics.
2.7s: cable/head wrapper still holds its final pose; 2.704s and 2.8s: wrapper is tiny after the 2ms removal gate.
Optional repeat resets animation and endpoints; no previous cable remains.
art_preflight_review.scope: Source/binary review only; queued fresh renders are not completed art approval.
